title: Gautrain and two Gauteng municipalities gain connected service accounts
summary: Gautrain, Johannesburg and Tshwane gain distinct accounts of rail opening, local transport, electricity, housing and water-service dependencies. Eligibility reaches 79 projects and 48 places, not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Eleven official HTML bodies and six official indexed-text records/excerpts inspected November 22. Direct-retrieval limits remain explicit. Permission, opening, plans, trial proposals, handover, pumping restart and household recovery are separate.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
